mstts:express-as.prosody: Welcome! I’m so glad you’re joining me for this journey—because what if I told you that sometimes, it’s not just ambition or talent that shapes where our careers go, but those tiny, unnoticed habits we all pick up along the way? You know, especially for women navigating today’s workplaces, there are these hidden patterns—little things we do, often without even realizing, that can quietly hold us back—even when we’re working hard and giving it our all. That’s exactly what Sally Helgesen explores in her insightful book, How Women Rise: Break the 12 Habits Holding You Back from Your Next Raise, Promotion, or Job. She shines a light on the challenges women face—not just because of skill or effort, but because of ways of thinking and acting that might have helped once, but aren’t serving us anymore. So, what are these habits? Well, together, we’ll look at twelve of them—from hesitating to claim credit for your achievements, to focusing so much on expertise that you miss out on being seen. Each one’s unpacked with empathy and understanding, showing how even our best intentions can sometimes trip us up. But here’s the encouraging part: this isn’t about changing who you are. It’s about noticing your strengths, shifting how you see yourself, and opening up to new strategies—so you can step forward, be recognized, and grow in ways that truly matter. As we explore these ideas, imagine what could happen—not just for you, but for the whole culture of work—if we all started making these small, powerful shifts. Ready to discover what’s possible? Let’s dive in together and see how little changes can make a big difference.
